title: Targeting FOXM1/Cystathionine-beta-Synthase Axis by Brusatol Inhibits Lung Cancer Malignant Progression.
authors: Wu, Yutong; Feng, Haipeng; Wang, Yichuan; Tian, Lili; Han, Chuanchun; Yan, Linping; Song, Jing; Shen, Dachuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Brusatol靶向FOXM1并抑制其与CBS启动子结合的抗肺癌机制，涉及分子对接和FOXM1-DNA结合，但核心是药物作用而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以实验为主。
abstract: Brusatol (BRU), an extract derived from Brucea javanica, has been shown to exert antitumor effects on various cancers, including lung cancer. However, its downstream molecular targets and the underlying mechanisms in lung cancer remain to be fully elucidated. Label-free quantitative proteomic analysis was used to identify the altered proteins in response to Brusatol treatment. The colony formation, Propidium iodide (PI) staining, and CCK8 were applied to detect cell proliferation, apoptosis, and cytotoxicity. Western blot and qRT-PCR were used to detect the expression of FOXM1 and CBS. The interaction between Brusatol and FOXM1 was validated by Streptavidin (SA)-based pulldown, Cellular Thermal Shift Assay, and molecular docking. In this study, we demonstrated that Brusatol directly interacts with FOXM1, leading to its degradation, thereby suppressing the malignant progression of lung cancer both in vitro and in vivo. Furthermore, our findings revealed that FOXM1 binds to the promoter region of Cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS) and enhances its expression in lung cancer cells. In addition, we evaluated the antitumor effects of Brusatol using a patient-derived organoid (PDO) model of lung cancer and observed that Brusatol significantly reduced cell viability, induced cell death, and downregulated the expression of both FOXM1 and CBS in PDOs. Moreover, a positive correlation between FOXM1 and CBS expression was identified in lung cancer. Taken together, our results indicate that Brusatol functions as a novel FOXM1 inhibitor and inhibits lung cancer progression by blocking the activation of the FOXM1/CBS signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 鸦胆子素（Brusatol, BRU）是从鸦胆子（Brucea javanica）中提取的一种成分，已被证明对包括肺癌在内的多种癌症具有抗肿瘤作用。然而，其在肺癌中的下游分子靶点及潜在机制仍有待全面阐明。采用无标记定量蛋白质组学分析来鉴定鸦胆子素处理下改变的蛋白质。集落形成、碘化丙啶（Propidium iodide, PI）染色和CCK8实验用于检测细胞增殖、凋亡和细胞毒性。Western blot和qRT-PCR用于检测FOXM1和CBS的表达。鸦胆子素与FOXM1之间的相互作用通过链霉亲和素（Streptavidin, SA）下拉实验、细胞热位移分析（Cellular Thermal Shift Assay）和分子对接（molecular docking）进行验证。在本研究中，我们证明鸦胆子素直接与FOXM1相互作用，导致其降解，从而在体外和体内抑制肺癌的恶性进展。此外，我们的研究结果揭示，FOXM1结合胱硫醚β-合酶（Cystathionine beta-synthase, CBS）的启动子区域，并在肺癌细胞中增强其表达。另外，我们使用肺癌患者来源的类器官（patient-derived organoid, PDO）模型评估了鸦胆子素的抗肿瘤效果，并观察到鸦胆子素显著降低细胞活力、诱导细胞死亡，并下调PDO中FOXM1和CBS的表达。此外，在肺癌中鉴定出FOXM1与CBS表达之间的正相关性。综上所述，我们的结果表明，鸦胆子素作为一种新型FOXM1抑制剂，通过阻断FOXM1/CBS信号轴的激活来抑制肺癌进展。
